The final candidate is awaiting approval, consumes the confirmed inputs, uses an executable Main-owned conflict resolution and commit, and filters harness-owned recorder events from the 14-path product/test audit.
gaps: The draft falsely claimed approved status and a 2026-09-12 approval for the new Decision 0074 revision.
The transition ordered the confirmed-spec correction after the requirements and plan gates that had to consume it.
The exact expected correction path set was narrower than the incumbent 78-path admission authority and lacked a deterministic rejection check.
factory/skills/forge.md contradicted native-main coordination but had no correction owner.

resolutions: Frontmatter and prose now state awaiting approval. They distinguish the approved 2026-09-12 chain from this amendment and require grill, first save, exact human approval, and unchanged second save before claiming authority.

Decision 0074 is committed; the spec was amended, cold-read once, recorded, and reconfirmed; and the current requirements pass is recorded before this plan pass and save. The correction worker no longer owns confirmation status or an unconfirmed spec amendment.

The effective 78-path admission and 180-file/18,000-line seal ceiling remain honest. Fourteen paths are the expected correction output; immediately before commit Main compares the post-merge/pre-delegation baseline to the working tree and untracked files, rejects any path outside the set, and verifies the same set after commit. Imported main changes are audited separately.

factory/skills/forge.md is assigned to First in the exact 14-path correction set and receives an explicit live-guidance alignment check alongside AGENTS, CLAUDE, README, ROLES, FACTORY, prompt, and spec surfaces.

The worker now fetches and runs git merge --no-commit, then stops without editing. Main resolves only plans/deferrals.md as an authorized orchestration-surface edit, preserving the three exact deferral rows; no scope widening is claimed.

The baseline-to-working-tree and postcommit expected-output checks exclude only harness-owned .factory/** state. Tracked and untracked product/test/documentation paths remain covered, and imported main paths remain a separate merge audit.
The worker never commits. Main performs the product/test audit after the worker returns and owns both the integration merge commit and correction commit.
Immediately after resolving plans/deferrals.md and before staging, Main requires the anchored rg conflict-marker search to return no matches and git diff --check to pass.
